CREATE TRIGGER "trg_product_changes_delete" AFTER DELETE ON "product" FOR EACH ROW
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO "product_change_queue" ("row_key", "write", "at", "before", "after")
  VALUES (OLD."id", 'delete', (CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000 + CAST(substr(strftime('%f', 'now'), 4) AS INTEGER)), json_object('title', CASE WHEN typeof(OLD."title") = 'blob' THEN hex(OLD."title") ELSE OLD."title" END, 'price', CASE WHEN typeof(OLD."price") = 'blob' THEN hex(OLD."price") ELSE OLD."price" END, 'note', CASE WHEN typeof(OLD."note") = 'blob' THEN hex(OLD."note") ELSE OLD."note" END, 'phase', CASE WHEN typeof(OLD."phase") = 'blob' THEN hex(OLD."phase") ELSE OLD."phase" END, 'phase_entered_at', CASE WHEN typeof(OLD."phase_entered_at") = 'blob' THEN hex(OLD."phase_entered_at") ELSE OLD."phase_entered_at" END), NULL);
END

CREATE TRIGGER "trg_product_changes_update" AFTER UPDATE ON "product" FOR EACH ROW
WHEN OLD."title" IS NOT NEW."title" OR OLD."price" IS NOT NEW."price" OR OLD."note" IS NOT NEW."note" OR OLD."phase" IS NOT NEW."phase" OR OLD."phase_entered_at" IS NOT NEW."phase_entered_at"
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO "product_change_queue" ("row_key", "write", "at", "before", "after")
  VALUES (NEW."id", 'update', (CAST(strftime('%s', 'now') AS INTEGER) * 1000 + CAST(substr(strftime('%f', 'now'), 4) AS INTEGER)), json_object('title', CASE WHEN typeof(OLD."title") = 'blob' THEN hex(OLD."title") ELSE OLD."title" END, 'price', CASE WHEN typeof(OLD."price") = 'blob' THEN hex(OLD."price") ELSE OLD."price" END, 'note', CASE WHEN typeof(OLD."note") = 'blob' THEN hex(OLD."note") ELSE OLD."note" END, 'phase', CASE WHEN typeof(OLD."phase") = 'blob' THEN hex(OLD."phase") ELSE OLD."phase" END, 'phase_entered_at', CASE WHEN typeof(OLD."phase_entered_at") = 'blob' THEN hex(OLD."phase_entered_at") ELSE OLD."phase_entered_at" END), json_object('title', CASE WHEN typeof(NEW."title") = 'blob' THEN hex(NEW."title") ELSE NEW."title" END, 'price', CASE WHEN typeof(NEW."price") = 'blob' THEN hex(NEW."price") ELSE NEW."price" END, 'note', CASE WHEN typeof(NEW."note") = 'blob' THEN hex(NEW."note") ELSE NEW."note" END, 'phase', CASE WHEN typeof(NEW."phase") = 'blob' THEN hex(NEW."phase") ELSE NEW."phase" END, 'phase_entered_at', CASE WHEN typeof(NEW."phase_entered_at") = 'blob' THEN hex(NEW."phase_entered_at") ELSE NEW."phase_entered_at" END));
END
